content.en: Poverty is defined as the inability to secure the minimum consumption basket required for basic human needs. In the **Indian Economy**, poverty is analyzed through both **Absolute Poverty** (lack of basic needs) and **Relative Poverty** (inequality in income distribution). The **NITI Aayog** and various expert committees have historically played a crucial role in defining the poverty line based on nutritional requirements and expenditure patterns.
